components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields

      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George

          type: string
          minLength: 1

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

## Summary

I implemented optional, unique owner email addresses. When an `email` is provided on owner creation, the app rejects it with **409 Conflict** if another owner already uses that email; otherwise it stores and returns it in the `email` response field.

Changes:

- **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `email` property (string, `format: email`, maxLength 255) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Since it's not in `required`, owners without an email still validate. This drives the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` and the MapStruct mapping (auto-mapped by name — no mapper change needed).
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `email` field with `@Column(name = "email")`, getter/setter, and `toString` entry.
- **`ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner`** — added an `isDuplicateEmail` check that runs only for new owners with a non-blank email, throwing the existing `DuplicateOwnerException` (already mapped to 409 in `ExceptionControllerAdvice`). Kept alongside the existing telephone-uniqueness check.
- **DB schemas** — added the `email` column to all four (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`); tests use `hsqldb`.
- **`data.sql`** (hsqldb, mysql) — appended `NULL` email to the positional owner inserts so seed data still loads (h2/postgres already use explicit column lists).
- **`JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl`** and **V1 `updateOwner`** — carried `email` through the JDBC SELECT/UPDATE statements and the update path for cross-profile coherence (JDBC profile isn't exercised by tests).
- **Tests** — added three to `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests`: email stored+returned on create, duplicate-email → 409 (distinct telephone so only email collides), and create-without-email still succeeds.

One scoping note: the 409 uniqueness applies to **creation** per the spec; `updateOwner` sets the email but does not run the duplicate check (consistent with the existing telephone behavior, which only guards `isNew()` owners).
